idea: 双条件极端共振：融合两个模板的极端检测逻辑，要求同时满足盈利修正极端（|zscore|>1）和效率比率极端（|zscore|>1）才触发交易，且交易标的为经清洗的效率比率，实现"情绪极端+基本面极端"的双重确认过滤。
expression_list: trade_when(and(greater(abs(quantile(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), driver=gaussian)), 1.0), greater(abs(quantile(winsorize(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), driver=gaussian)), 1.0)), winsorize(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), 0)

trade_when(and(greater(abs(quantile(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), driver=gaussian)), 1.0), greater(abs(quantile(winsorize(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), driver=gaussian)), 1.0)), winsorize(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), 0)
